name: TopFollower
description: JSON Structure description for Sorsa top-follower.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Account creation date in ISO 8601 format.

fields.name: followers_count
fields.description: Number of accounts following this user.

fields.name: followings_count
fields.description: Number of accounts this user follows.

fields.name: profile_background_image_url
fields.description: URL of the user's profile background image.

fields.name: profile_image_url
fields.description: URL of the user's avatar image.

fields.name: protected
fields.description: Whether the account's tweets are protected (private).

fields.name: score
fields.description: Whether the account accepts direct messages.

fields.name: tweets_count
fields.description: Total number of tweets posted by this user.

fields.name: verified
fields.description: Whether the account has a verified badge.
